input.text: (LinkedIn InMail) Hi! I'm Bastian Quillfeather, a consultant at Michael Page in the digital and design practice. I'm working on a 9-month contract Senior Product Designer engagement with Figma, remote within the US. Contract roles we place are not always listed on the client's careers page. Would you be open to a quick call? If so, I'll share the full brief and the rate range.

notes: LinkedIn InMail with no sender domain. Recruiter is unlabeled: verified_intermediary (Michael Page is established) and could_not_verify (the individual cannot be tied to it) are both defensible. Neither is a warning.
